knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A test piece shows how the stain takes on this timber under good light, before the visible surface is stained.
Dry to touch is not cured. Hand back only after the stated cure time.
Piled oily rags can create a fire risk. The approved storage procedure applies.

practicalCriteria: Colour judged on a test piece under good light and recorded
Coats applied thin and even, with no runs
Sanding between coats carried out with extraction and respirator controls
Piece held to the stated cure time before handover
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% or higher. With three checks this means all three must be correct. Practical sign-off is separate: every practical criterion must be observed and met by the assessor. A knowledge pass is not practical competence and does not count toward sign-off.
evidenceRequired: Product batch numbers, coats and cure times
stopWorkCriteria: Uneven coats left unrepaired on a visible surface
